headline: Medium data-leakage and cascading-error risks from shared workspace content and browser-backed search; no direct prompt-injection channel is documented.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile shows a direct automated channel between them, but both can be bridged by manual copy-paste or shared workspace content. Notion AI is workspace-grounded and Perplexity can browse and summarize external content, so prompt-like text could be transferred, but no shared MCP or filesystem bridge is documented.
conditions: IF an operator copies Perplexity output into Notion pages as instructions
IF Notion page content is pasted into Perplexity prompts without review
mitigations: Use a fixed template that separates instructions from quoted content
Add a one-line provenance note before pasted excerpts
Review pasted text for imperative language before reuse

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while Perplexity handles uploaded documents and browsing context. In default use, either agent can expose sensitive workspace or document content to vendor-hosted backends, so the pair creates a realistic leakage path even without host execution.
conditions: IF workspace pages contain confidential team knowledge
IF uploaded documents to Perplexity include sensitive material
mitigations: Restrict both tools to non-sensitive projects
Redact secrets before pasting or uploading
Use separate accounts for sensitive and general work

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents are vendor-hosted and lack filesystem write, shell, or git modification, so direct resource contention is limited. The main overlap is shared workspace or uploaded-document handling, which can cause conflicting edits or duplicated analysis, but the blast radius is usually small and reversible.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same shared document set
IF one agent's edits are manually copied into the other's workspace
mitigations: Assign one agent as editor and the other as reviewer
Use separate copies of the same source document
Timestamp and label the latest authoritative version

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity performs multi-hop browsing and Notion AI is RAG-style over workspace content, so one agent's output can become the other's input without a built-in verification step. That creates a plausible chain where hallucinated or stale claims are re-rendered or acted on, though neither profile shows autonomous external action-taking.
conditions: IF Perplexity answers are pasted into Notion as source material
IF Notion summaries are reused as factual input for further Perplexity queries
mitigations: Require a human check of cited claims before reuse
Keep original source links alongside summaries
Mark generated text as unverified until checked

E_compliance.rationale: Both agents are closed-source, vendor-hosted, and process workspace or uploaded-document content through vendor backends. The profiles do not specify residency or retention guarantees, so compliance risk is plausible for regulated data classes, but the evidence is insufficient to claim a specific breach like HIPAA or EU-only violations.
conditions: IF regulated data is entered into Notion pages or Perplexity uploads
IF the organization requires a specific residency or retention policy not documented here
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in both tools
Check vendor privacy and retention settings before use
Route sensitive workflows to approved systems only
